name: Altitude Sports
description: Canadian online retailer of outdoor, ski, camping, running and lifestyle apparel, footwear and gear from outdoor and fashion brands. Its help center states free standard shipping within Canada over 74 dollars and that it does not ship outside Canada; the site also carries a separate Marketplace section.
description_es: Tienda canadiense en línea de ropa, calzado y equipo para exteriores, esquí, camping, running y estilo de vida. Su centro de ayuda indica envío estándar gratis dentro de Canadá sobre 74 dólares y que no envía fuera de Canadá; el sitio incluye además una sección Marketplace.

ships_to.notes: Free standard shipping in Canada over 74 dollars (Marketplace items excluded); remote-area fees apply; does not ship outside Canada.

shopping_notes: Same-day delivery in Greater Montreal and next-day in the GTA, Ottawa and Quebec City are described in its help center; confirm at checkout. Marketplace items are sold by third parties and have separate shipping terms.

sources.supports: Canada-only shipping, free shipping threshold, same-day and next-day cities
